	has_country_flag = zin_people_sun_elves
}

		has_country_flag = zin_people_elves

zin_sun_is_runner = {
	OR = {
		original_tag = Y6X
		AND = {
			NOT = { country_exists = Y6X }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = zin_sun_council_president
				AND = {
					zin_sun_is_sunhot_realm = yes
					NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = zin_sun_council_president } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
